fit: Breyer writes for the concrete separation between an actual protected personal information interest, alleged reputational effects and the available remedial channel, which his recent MacArthur opinion performs. That work directly answers why the incorporated adverse report does not by itself establish the present habeas injury while preserving noncategorical treatment of reputation. His Garlotte and Edwards joins also retain the separate custody and civil-remedy reservations. Scalia is the strongest equal-count alternative through Lujan and Edwards; Breyer's authored treatment of the precise personal-information/remedy distinction supplies the combined fit without importing MacArthur's Privacy Act cause into habeas. Stone is not eligible for the whole lead because fallback does not adopt its ancillary custody, exception and Heck grounds. Stevens writes the dissent to preserve his own Lane distinction and actual-adjudication injury ground; no new claim or historical author is imported.
